# netactuate_secret_values (Data Source)

Reads Secret Values visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_secret_values" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `values` (List of Object) All secret values visible to the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values))

<a id="nestedatt--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `values`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number)
- `secret_key` (String)
